SELECT u.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nick_name, ''), u.user_name) AS nickName, u.phone_number AS phone, u.create_time AS createTime, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM special_appointment a WHERE a.user_id = u.user_id AND a.del_flag = '0' ) AS appointmentCount FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id AND r.del_flag = '0' AND r.role_key = 'special_parent' WHERE u.del_flag = '0'
AND ( u.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.phone_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY u.create_time DESC
